title: PS5 Black Friday deals 2026 UK: the best console prices now

description: PS5 Black Friday 2026: where PS5 and PS5 Pro stock is at the normal price, PS Portal prices and what to avoid while GTA VI demand is high.
intro:
**Short answer: there's still no real PS5 console discount this Black Friday, because stock has run short at most UK shops since GTA VI launched on 19 November.** The best console buys right now are Very's **PS5 Digital + GTA VI + DualSense Edge bundle at £699** and EE's **PS5 Slim Disc with a second DualSense and a £100 EE Game Card at £689.98**. Don't pay resellers: on Amazon the new PS5 Pro has been sold only by marketplace sellers, from about £1,299.

Controllers, headsets and games are the real deals: the DualSense Edge is **£149 at Amazon**, the Turtle Beach Atlas 200 headset is £34.99 and the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 Gen 2 £108, and Saros is £29.99 and Marvel's Wolverine £39 (all Amazon). A £70 PlayStation Store code is £60.85 at ShopTo. Black Friday is tomorrow, 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to 30 November. Prices last checked on Thursday 26 November 2026 at 10am. For other gaming and tech deals, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

body:
## PS5 prices to aim for this Black Friday

PS5 prices went up in April 2026: the Digital Edition from £429.99 to £519.99, the disc model from £479.99 to £569.99 and the PS5 Pro from £699.99 to £789.99. That makes last year's deals a less direct guide, but they show how far Sony is willing to go.

- **Black Friday 2025:** Sony's own promotion cut the Digital Edition to £294.99, the disc model to £389.99 and the PS5 Pro to £609.99, and most big retailers matched it. Argos went further on the Pro, selling it for £569.99.
- **Lowest prices in the last six months (Which?):** about £375 for the Digital Edition, £442 for the disc model and £570 for the Pro.
- **Our targets for 2026:** under £400 for the Digital Edition, under £450 for the disc model and under £650 for the PS5 Pro. Any of those is a good deal at the new prices.

## Which PS5 should you buy?

**PS5 Digital Edition:** the cheapest way in. Games are bought as downloads from the PlayStation Store, which means no second-hand games. You can add Sony's disc drive later if you change your mind, but it costs extra.

**PS5 with disc drive:** worth the extra if you buy games on disc, trade them in or borrow them, or want to play 4K Blu-rays. Over a few years, cheaper second-hand games can cover the price difference.

**PS5 Pro:** sharper picture and smoother frame rates on a good 4K TV. It doesn't come with a disc drive. Only worth the big premium if you play a lot and have a TV that shows the difference.

**Certified Refurbished:** sold by Sony with a warranty, and £90 to £120 less than new. A sensible choice if you need a console before Black Friday.

## Will the PS5 be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

Update, 26 November: probably not this year. Grand Theft Auto VI came out on 19 November and sold in huge numbers, and many people bought a PS5 to play it. Since then the standard consoles have sold out at Currys and John Lewis, and the GTA VI bundles we listed last week from EE, Very and O2 are no longer things we can confirm at those prices, so we've taken them off. Resellers have pushed prices up sharply: What Hi-Fi saw the PS5 Digital at up to £899 and the PS5 Pro at £1,475 from third-party sellers.

What to do: buy only from a big retailer at or near Sony's prices (£519.99 Digital, £569.99 disc, £789.99 Pro), set stock alerts at Argos and Amazon, and accept a bundle with a second controller if that's all that's in stock. Sony may still run its own Black Friday promotion on games, PS Plus and accessories, which doesn't depend on console stock. Very's PS5 Digital + GTA VI + DualSense Edge bundle at £699 and EE's PS5 Slim Disc bundle at £689.98 are the most sensible console offers we've found from big retailers (GamesRadar and TechRadar UK, 26 November). Accessories are the genuine PS5 deals this week: the DualSense Edge is £149 at Amazon, and headsets and this year's big games are cut too (prices checked 26 November). [Check Amazon's DualSense prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=DualSense+wireless+controller).

### Why is the PS5 out of stock in the UK?

Demand jumped when GTA VI launched on 19 November, just before Black Friday. Currys and John Lewis have sold out of the standard consoles, and Argos and Amazon have mostly bundles left.

### Is it worth buying a PS5 now or waiting for Black Friday?

If you find a PS5 in stock at a big retailer at Sony's normal price, buy it: with stock this short, waiting for a discount is more likely to leave you without one. Never pay a reseller hundreds over the normal price; stock usually recovers after the Christmas rush.

### When do PS5 Black Friday deals start?

Bundle deals started in mid-November, but most sold out after GTA VI's launch on 19 November. Last year Sony's promotion ran from 21 November to Cyber Monday; this year, with consoles scarce, expect any savings to be on games, PS Plus and accessories rather than the consoles.

### Should I buy a PS5 Digital Edition or the disc version?

Digital if you're happy buying all your games online. Disc if you like second-hand games or lending games to friends, as the savings on games add up.

### Is a refurbished PS5 worth it?

Sony's Certified Refurbished consoles are checked and come with a warranty, so they're a safe buy. The Digital Edition was £429.99 when we checked on 22 October; we couldn't confirm today's price, and it may have gone up. With new consoles scarce this year, refurbished is worth a look.

See also our [Black Friday 2026 guides](/black-friday/), including [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), and [what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/).
